title: armeria maritima var. capitella
intro: Armeria maritima var. capitella, commonly known as Sea Thrift or Dwarf Thrift, is a flowering plant species within the plantain family (Plumbaginaceae). It is known for its pink, white, or purple flowers and its use in traditional medicine, particularly in the treatment of respiratory issues and digestive problems. The plant is believed to have health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions including bronchodilatory, expectorant, and anti-ulcerogenic effects. The bioactive constituents of Armeria maritima var. capitella include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
